features.woocommerce_query_adapter: taxonomy, price, stock, sale and rating foundation implemented

notes: WooCommerce minimum/tested ranges remain unset until the Phase 0 environment audit and compatibility matrix are completed.
Public URL parameters are allow-listed from the normalized filter definition schema; arbitrary request keys are not converted into product queries.
The first query adapter slice uses public WooCommerce/WordPress tax and meta query APIs. Price lookup optimization is deferred to the Phase 4 cache/index workstream.
The module does not patch WooCommerce or Theme source and remains optional/installable independently from presentation packages.
